articles.title: Agents, Molecules & the SaaS-mageddon
articles.description:
In this episode, we dive into the seismic shifts happening in industrial AI, from the so-called 'SaaS-mageddon' disrupting established software models to the rise of AI-powered agents that promise to redefine productivity. We share first-hand insights on how large language models and open-source projects are reshaping the landscape, and what this means for the future of industry solutions.

We then turn to the frontier of pharmaceutical innovation with Stanisław Jastrzębski, CTO & Co-Founder from molecule.one, who reveals how deep learning, automation, and custom data are accelerating drug discovery. Join us as we connect the dots between industrial AI trends, the evolution of personal assistants, and the chemistry breakthroughs powering tomorrow’s medicines. Tune in for a global perspective and a dash of inspiration straight from the heart of Istanbul.
